content.title: Morning Selfie Continuity | Identity-Locked Routine Across Rooms
content.summary: An adult museum guide compresses five morning actions into one departure route. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity and handheld selfie carrier persist through all routine chapters. + Each location change uses a visible face, hand or prop handoff. + Every chapter contributes one completed morning action rather than decorative posing. + Wardrobe change is bounded and preserves the same face, hair and body proportions. + The final outdoor movement proves departure from the private routine into a destination route.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one adult museum guide with a short black bob and silver ear cuff in a handheld morning selfie inside a small apartment. Reconnect her in a rust field jacket while she fastens the same ear cuff and packs one folded map. Outside, keep the same identity and jacket as she waves once, turns forward and walks toward the museum entrance.

invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
